offences.quote: This is a breach of academic integrity, which UC’s regulations define as a “Principle by which University staff and students act honestly, fairly, ethically, responsibly and with due care in academic work.”

detection.quote: AI writing detectors, specifically Turnitin, are used in some courses at UC as an initial step to identify assignments that may need closer attention.
but would not generally be used as the sole piece of evidence for inappropriate use of AI.
However, it may be flagged if you are using Grammarly extensively or using it to rewrite or compose text, which is generative AI.
collect any evidence that supports your position including any earlier drafts, workings, and/or planning notes.

process.quote: Depending on the severity of the inappropriate use, it could lead to an academic misconduct investigation.

If you’ve been accused of using AI inappropriately and you don’t believe you have, you should discuss this with the Lecturer/Course Coordinator, Academic Integrity Officer, or Proctor who has made the allegation.

definitions.quote: Gen-AI refers to AI systems capable of creating content such as text, translated text, images, video or code.
